intro.subject: Welcome to Reset Society
intro.body: Welcome to Reset Society — a creator-first space for connection, collaboration and purposeful work. Start with the public gateway, then join Discord voluntarily when you are ready.

welcome.subject: Your Reset Society starting point
welcome.body: You are in. Review the community expectations, choose the spaces that fit your work and keep private rights, payment and account information out of public channels.

purchase_confirmation.subject: Your RESET service payment is confirmed
purchase_confirmation.body: Stripe confirmed your payment for {{offer_name}}. Reference: {{order_reference}}. RESET will provide the documented fulfillment steps and timing for this specific service. Discord membership is not included unless an approved offer explicitly says otherwise.

renewal_notice.subject: Upcoming RESET renewal
renewal_notice.body: Your {{offer_name}} renewal is scheduled for {{renewal_date}} at {{amount}}. Use the secure billing link in your account or contact RESET support before the renewal date if you need help.

failed_payment.subject: Action needed for your RESET payment
failed_payment.body: Stripe could not complete the payment for {{offer_name}}. No card details are handled by RESET. Use the secure Stripe billing or checkout link to review your payment method.

inquiry_acknowledgment.subject: RESET received your inquiry
inquiry_acknowledgment.body: We received your message and routed it to {{routing_team}}. Reference: {{inquiry_reference}}. Please do not reply with passwords, card information or confidential creator-rights documents.

support_acknowledgment.subject: RESET support request received
support_acknowledgment.body: Your support request is logged as {{support_reference}} with priority {{priority}}. We will respond through the official RESET support channel.

event_confirmation.subject: Your RESET event registration is confirmed
event_confirmation.body: Your registration for {{event_name}} on {{event_date}} is confirmed. Access instructions: {{access_instructions}}. Recording occurs only when clearly disclosed for that event.
